Title: Free health services available at every government facility
Description: Delivery, medicines, tests, ambulance, TB treatment, dialysis, cataract surgery and much more are provided free of cost at government health facilities in Sheikhpura. If anyone asks you to pay for these, call 104 and complain.

Title: Ayushman Arogya Mandir now open in every panchayat
Description: Your nearest Health Sub-Centre now provides twelve health services free — pregnancy care, child care, immunisation, treatment of common illnesses, screening for blood pressure and diabetes, and free video consultation with a doctor.

Title: Free screening for blood pressure, diabetes and cancer
Description: Everyone aged 30 and above can get free screening for high blood pressure, diabetes and common cancers. Your ASHA can test you at home, or visit your nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir. Medicines are also free every month.

Title: 102 and 108 ambulances are free — including the ride home
Description: Dial 102 for pregnant women and newborns, and 108 for any medical emergency or accident. The ambulance comes to you, the service is free, and it drops you back home after discharge. Nobody may charge you for it.

Title: TB treatment is free, and patients receive monthly nutrition support
Description: Testing and the complete course of TB medicines are free at every government facility, including for drug-resistant TB. Every notified patient also receives money in their bank account each month for nutrition throughout treatment.

Title: Quarterly District Health Society meeting
Description: The quarterly governing body meeting of the District Health Society, Sheikhpura will be chaired by the District Magistrate.
